purpose: new post-correction, source-distinct confirmatory event-workflow frame; not a replacement score for failed v1 cases
source_rule: Two latest adjacent reported fiscal quarters with earnings releases filed by 2025-12-31 as SEC 8-K EX-99.1 artifacts; check fiscal period, metric basis, unit and source bytes before any model answer. Preserve the old FOUR EX-99.2 exception; never silently broaden its pair rule.
selection_policy: Include every unobserved v1 primary and each unobserved v1 reserve. Add exactly one bank, the smallest SHA-256 rank of ranking_seed plus stratum plus ticker in the frozen extension pool. If an issuer fails the source rule, document the source-ineligibility reason before choosing the next unused ranked candidate from that stratum; never replace a case for model quality or workflow outcome.
case_gate: Retain the v1 predeclared F/I/R/S/U all-five fact/state and at-least-four-high gate; no outcome-based retries. A new v2 protocol must record the complete model-facing intervention and code hashes before any paid call.
scope_limit: This issuer frame supports only single-issuer event-to-review cluster independence. Screening and portfolio workflows still require separate source-disjoint packet frames or dependence-aware analysis.
